versions.subject: WMI spawning PowerShell seen in various attacks
versions.detection:
selection:
    ParentImage:
        - '*\wmiprvse.exe'
    Image:
        - '*\powershell.exe'
filter:
    CommandLine:
        - '*&*'
condition: selection and not filter
versions.spl: ParentImage="*\\wmiprvse.exe" Image="*\\powershell.exe" NOT CommandLine="*&*"

versions.subject: fix: null values in separate filter expression > null value in lists cause problems in some backends
versions.detection:
selection:
    ParentImage:
        - '*\wmiprvse.exe'
    Image:
        - '*\powershell.exe'
filter_null1:
    CommandLine: 'null'
filter_null2:  # some backends need the null value in a seperate expression
    CommandLine: null
condition: selection and not filter_null1 and not filter_null2
versions.spl: ParentImage="*\\wmiprvse.exe" Image="*\\powershell.exe" NOT CommandLine="null" NOT NOT CommandLine=*
